name: Origin UI
summary: Free MIT React+Tailwind components (now coss ui on Base UI); originui.com → coss.com/ui.
license: MIT (apps/ui + apps/origin; see LICENSING.md — repo default AGPLv3 elsewhere)
gaps: originui.com permanently redirects to https://coss.com/ui (Cal.com acquisition / rebrand).
Catalog id remains `origin-ui` per EXPAND-QUEUE; live docs/registry are coss ui (@coss).
Pilot includes 12 of 56+ registry:ui primitives — not full inventory; particles (p-*) and legacy /origin snapshot not ingested.
License honesty: MIT applies to apps/ui and apps/origin only; rest of monorepo is AGPLv3 (LICENSING.md).
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Base UI button with coss design tokens.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add @coss/button

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button>Click me</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use Origin UI / coss ui free MIT component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://coss.com/ui/docs/components/button (originui.com redirects here). Install with `npx shadcn@latest add @coss/button` (@coss registry: https://coss.com/ui/r/{name}.json). Imports land under `@/components/ui/button`. Exports: Button, buttonVariants. Requires React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Base UI. License: MIT for apps/ui and apps/origin (https://github.com/cosscom/coss/blob/main/LICENSING.md) — repo default AGPLv3 does NOT apply to these dirs. Pricing free. Prefer @coss primitives; legacy Origin particles remain at https://coss.com/origin.
